trip.title: Dolomites Trip Dashboard
trip.routeSummary: Lake Garda → Schgaguler Hotel (Kastelruth) → Golden Hill (Dobbiaco / Toblach) → Venice
trip.intro: Built for deep trip operations while traveling: dynamic hotel routes, base-aware recommendations, primary/alternate/bad-weather plans, and quick links to Google Maps, AllTrails, and booking pages. Internal base IDs are kept for web compatibility, but the live trip is optimized for Schgaguler Hotel in Kastelruth on the West side and Golden Hill in Dobbiaco / Toblach on the East side.

seceda_primary.name: [Seceda - Val Gardena] Col Raiser - Seceda - Pieralongia - Rifugio Firenze
seceda_primary.reason: Best blend of jagged ridgeline, green pasture, and huts without too much dead time.
seceda_primary.access: Lift strongly recommended: use the Col Raiser valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Best parking: Col Raiser parking at the valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Direct Seceda lift / Parking + Garage Seceda (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei) is a backup access point, but Col Raiser is the better fit for this route.
seceda_primary.booking: Day-of is usually fine; arrive for first wave.

seceda_secondary.name: [Seceda - Val Gardena] Seceda - Rifugio Firenze - Col Raiser - Mastlè
seceda_secondary.reason: Slightly more compact Seceda variant with similar payoff.
seceda_secondary.access: Lift strongly recommended: use the Col Raiser valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Best parking: Col Raiser parking at the valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Direct Seceda lift / Parking + Garage Seceda (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei) is a backup access point, but Col Raiser is the better fit for this route.

adolf_munkel_primary.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Adolf Munkel Trail
adolf_munkel_primary.reason: One of the best meadow + hut + Odle backdrop hikes in the Dolomites.
adolf_munkel_primary.access: No lift. Start from Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). Best parking: Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss); reserve/check access if possible because the Ranui signal-light system controls valley traffic.
adolf_munkel_primary.cost: Parking fee on site if applicable
adolf_munkel_primary.booking: Reserve if possible; otherwise go early.

adolf_munkel_short.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Rifugio delle Odle via Sentiero Adolf Munkel
adolf_munkel_short.reason: Shorter Odle-hut payoff and one of the best practical lower-commitment backups from the Schgaguler base.
adolf_munkel_short.access: No lift. Start from Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). Best parking: Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss); reserve/check access if possible because the Ranui signal-light system controls valley traffic.
adolf_munkel_short.cost: Parking fee on site if applicable

santa_maddalena_panoramic.name: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Santa Maddalena: Panoramic Path
santa_maddalena_panoramic.reason: Best church / meadow / village composition for your taste.
santa_maddalena_panoramic.access: No lift. Start from Santa Maddalena village / visitor-center parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy) and follow local access signs toward the panoramic path. Best parking: village/designated parking near Santa Maddalena (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); keep the Puez-Geisler visitor-center area (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena) as a backup parking reference.

santa_maddalena_viewpoint.name: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Viewpoint Santa Maddalena
santa_maddalena_viewpoint.reason: Best short photo-stop version if you want minimal effort.
santa_maddalena_viewpoint.access: No lift. Start from Santa Maddalena village / visitor-center parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy) and follow local access signs toward the panoramic path. Best parking: village/designated parking near Santa Maddalena (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); keep the Puez-Geisler visitor-center area (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena) as a backup parking reference.

hans_paula_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Hans & Paula Steger Trail
hans_paula_primary.reason: Best low-effort rolling green meadow day with Sassolungo backdrop.
hans_paula_primary.access: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) is the most practical from Schgaguler for a Compatsch start. Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern). Drive-up alternative: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you are already on the plateau early; road access is restricted later in the day.
hans_paula_primary.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip

bullaccia_secondary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Bullaccia Tour: Witches’ Benches
bullaccia_secondary.reason: Best Alpe di Siusi alternate if you want more viewpoint emphasis.
bullaccia_secondary.access: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) is the most practical from Schgaguler for Compatsch / Bullaccia starts. Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern). Drive-up alternative: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you arrive before the road restriction window.

cinque_torri_primary.name: [Cinque Torri - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Cinque Torri – Averau | Nuvolau Refuge
cinque_torri_primary.reason: Strong scenery-per-hour with broader ridge panoramas than the tiny towers-only loop.
cinque_torri_primary.access: Lift optional. Start from Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones). Best parking: Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones). Use the 5 Torri chairlift from Bai de Dones if you want to skip the least-interesting lower ascent and save time for the rifugi section.

tre_cime_primary.name: [Tre Cime - Misurina] Three Peaks of Lavaredo
tre_cime_primary.reason: Best iconic white-rock payoff per hour and the most recognizable East Dolomites hike.
tre_cime_primary.access: No lift. Start from Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking). Best parking: Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking) via the mandatory prebooked Auronzo toll-road reservation.

cadini_primary.name: [Tre Cime / Cadini - Misurina] Cadini di Misurina Panoramic Viewpoint via Auronzo Hut
cadini_primary.reason: Massive reward for little time and best paired with the same Auronzo reservation day.
cadini_primary.access: No lift once at the trailhead. Start from Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking). Best parking: Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking); same access day as Tre Cime.
cadini_primary.cost: Included in same €40 Auronzo road day

sorapis_primary.name: [Lago di Sorapis - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Lake Sorapis via Passo Tre Croci
sorapis_primary.reason: Best turquoise-lake option that still fits your realistic time ceiling.
sorapis_primary.access: No lift. Start from Passo Tre Croci (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Passo+Tre+Croci). Best parking: roadside / pass-area parking at Passo Tre Croci (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Passo+Tre+Croci); arrive early because spaces are limited.

monte_piz_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Monte Piz – Schgaguler Hut via Monte Sëuc
monte_piz_primary.reason: Best overall Alpe di Siusi ROI from Schgaguler when you use lift access to start directly on the prettier upper plateau.
monte_piz_primary.access: Lift recommended: take the Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola). Best parking: Garage Mont Sëuc (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) right by the lift; Garage Central / town parking is a secondary option. This route is best done from the upper plateau so you skip the less-pretty lower approach.
monte_piz_primary.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; Garage Mont Sëuc parking extra.
monte_piz_primary.booking: Day-of usually fine; go earlier if weather is best in the morning.

tschotsch_short.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Tschötsch Alm – Puflatsch Bergstation
tschotsch_short.reason: Best ultra-short Alpe di Siusi scenic hit if you want a lighter arrival-day hike with viewpoint payoff.
tschotsch_short.access: Lift recommended: use the Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) for the quickest access to the Compatsch / plateau side. Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern) if you want covered parking. Drive-up alternative: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you are already on the plateau early.
tschotsch_short.cost: Seis cable car / plateau access fare or plateau parking fees apply.

bullaccia_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Bullaccia Tour: Witches’ Benches
bullaccia_primary.reason: Best bigger Alpe di Siusi loop when you want more viewpoint drama than Hans & Paula and are fine using lift access.
bullaccia_primary.access: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) is the most practical from Schgaguler for Compatsch / Bullaccia starts. Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern). Drive-up alternative: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you arrive before the road restriction window.
bullaccia_primary.cost: Seis cable car fare or Compatsch parking fees apply.

alpe_family_tour.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Alpe di Siusi Family Tour
alpe_family_tour.reason: Very good easy plateau sampler with broad Dolomite views if you want a softer scenic day without losing the classic Alpe di Siusi look.
alpe_family_tour.access: Lift recommended: use the Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) to start around Compatsch. Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern). Drive-up alternative: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you arrive before restrictions.
alpe_family_tour.cost: Seis cable car fare or Compatsch parking fees apply.

urtijei_seiser_alm.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Urtijëi - Seiser Alm
urtijei_seiser_alm.reason: A stronger longer Alpe di Siusi option with high visual payoff if you want more plateau time and are happy to use the Mont Sëuc access from Ortisei.
urtijei_seiser_alm.access: Lift recommended: take the Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola). Best parking: Garage Mont Sëuc (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) at the station; Parking + Garage Seceda (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei) is only relevant if you are already parking in Ortisei center.
urtijei_seiser_alm.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; parking extra.
urtijei_seiser_alm.booking: Day-of usually fine; clearer weather improves this route.

zans_glatsch.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Zans | Zannes - Malga Glatsch Alm
zans_glatsch.reason: Good lighter Zans-area alternative when you want a hut reward and Odle scenery without committing to the fuller Adolf Munkel outing.
zans_glatsch.access: No lift. Start from Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). Best parking: Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss); same Ranui access-control considerations as the other Zans hikes.

sellaronda_drive.name: Sellaronda Scenic Loop
sellaronda_drive.summary: Best full West-side bad-weather scenic loop from Schgaguler when you still want major pass scenery; slightly less effortless than starting in Ortisei, but still very strong from Kastelruth.

val_di_funes_drive.name: Val di Funes Scenic Drive
val_di_funes_drive.summary: Best lower-valley scenic backup from Schgaguler for churches, meadows, farms, and villages when high ridges are not worth committing to.

great_dolomite_transfer.name: Great Dolomites Road practical transfer
great_dolomite_transfer.summary: Best scenic hotel-transfer route from Schgaguler to Golden Hill, turning the move east into a pass-heavy drive with white-rock drama.

east_bad_weather_loop.name: Passo Giau longer East scenic loop
east_bad_weather_loop.summary: Longer East-side road day from Golden Hill when hiking is not worthwhile and you still want a fuller dramatic-drive option beyond the Misurina corridor.

tre_cime_misurina_drive.name: Tre Cime / Misurina approach mini-drive
tre_cime_misurina_drive.summary: Best short East-side scenic fallback from Golden Hill when the full Auronzo or Sorapis commitment is not worth it but you still want nearby lake-and-white-rock scenery.

parkingTable.name: Zans Parking
parkingTable.rules: 2026 uses Ranui signal-light system and some pre-bookable spaces.

parkingTable.name: Santa Maddalena village / visitor-center area
parkingTable.rules: Use designated village parking and follow local signs; exact official English lot naming is not clear.

parkingTable.name: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola valley station
parkingTable.rules: Simplest gondola access for this itinerary.

parkingTable.name: P1 Spitzbühl
parkingTable.rules: Road restricted 9:00–17:00; can close earlier when full.

parkingTable.name: P2 Compatsch
parkingTable.rules: Road restricted 9:00–17:00; machine payment before exit.

parkingTable.name: Bai de Dones
parkingTable.rules: Chairlift optional; current summer first runs around 9:00.

parkingTable.name: Rifugio Auronzo Parking
parkingTable.rules: Mandatory online reservation; permit valid 12 hours.

parkingTable.name: Passo Tre Croci area
parkingTable.rules: No lift. Arrive early for parking.

parkingTable.name: Garage Mont Sëuc
parkingTable.serves: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc lift access
parkingTable.rules: Chargeable garage at the bottom station of the Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola. Best practical parking for Monte Piz and Urtijëi - Seiser Alm.

parkingTable.name: Car park Silbernagl (P1)
parkingTable.rules: Covered parking at the valley station area of the Seiser Alm cableway; good practical choice for Bullaccia, Family Tour, and other Compatsch-side hikes.

parkingTable.name: Parking + Garage Seceda
parkingTable.serves: Direct Seceda lift backup access from Ortisei
parkingTable.rules: Chargeable parking at the Seceda cableway bottom station; useful backup access point but not the primary recommendation for the Col Raiser-based Seceda route.
parkingTable.cost: €4/hour daytime listed on Dolomiti Superski parking page.

bookings.note: Mandatory for Day 6; reserve when date opens.
Review the current Zans / Ranui reservation-access rules before the Adolf Munkel day.
Day-of purchase usually fine if you arrive early.

d1_arrival_santa_short.title: Optional Santa Maddalena short stop
d1_arrival_santa_short.summary: Fallback arrival-day church/meadow stop if the plateau is too clouded in or you prefer to avoid lift logistics on Day 1.
d1_arrival_santa_short.whenToUse: Use on arrival day if higher terrain is not worth it or if you want a no-lift backup.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: Santa Maddalena village / designated parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); visitor-center area backup (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d1_arrival_santa_short.mentalMap: Church-view and meadow stop with lower weather commitment than a plateau hike.

d1_arrival_town_reset.title: Kastelruth reset
d1_arrival_town_reset.summary: Skip hiking and ease into the trip with a quiet first afternoon in Kastelruth.
d1_arrival_town_reset.whenToUse: Best if arrival is delayed or energy is low.
logistics: No parking/logistics stress.
Good for settling in and preserving energy.
d1_arrival_town_reset.mentalMap: Simple arrival buffer in your actual base village.

d1_val_di_funes_drive.title: Val di Funes scenic drive
d1_val_di_funes_drive.summary: Best mixed/bad-weather fallback from Schgaguler on arrival when you still want villages, churches, and meadow scenery.
d1_val_di_funes_drive.whenToUse: Use when peaks are clouded in but valley scenery is still visible.
logistics: Flexible scenic stops.
Easy to shorten if weather worsens.
d1_val_di_funes_drive.mentalMap: Villages, church views, meadows, and easier visibility than high ridges.

d2_seceda_primary.title: Seceda hero day from Kastelruth
d2_seceda_primary.summary: Your clearest-sky West-side hero day, now routed from Schgaguler.
d2_seceda_primary.whenToUse: Use on the clearest West-side day.
logistics: Park at Col Raiser valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena).

Lift strongly recommended: Col Raiser (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Direct Seceda parking/lift (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei) is only a backup access point.
bookings: Arrive for the first wave; day-of purchase usually fine.
d2_seceda_primary.mentalMap: Dramatic ridgeline above green pastures and huts.

d2_adolf_short_alt.title: Adolf Munkel shorter backup
d2_adolf_short_alt.summary: Lower-commitment alternate if Seceda feels too weather-sensitive or you want less exposure.
d2_adolf_short_alt.whenToUse: Best if weather is mixed, visibility is decent in the valley, or you want a shorter/meadow-focused day.
logistics: Use Zans access rules.
Shorter Odle payoff than the full classic route.
bookings: Reserve if possible; otherwise go early.

d2_sellaronda_bad.title: Sellaronda scenic drive
d2_sellaronda_bad.summary: Best true bad-weather fallback from Schgaguler if Seceda is not worth committing to.
d2_sellaronda_bad.whenToUse: Use when high hiking terrain is not worth it.
logistics: Road-trip day with multiple pass pull-offs.
Easy to shorten or extend.
d2_sellaronda_bad.mentalMap: Pass-driven wow-factor day instead of committing to a lift.

d3_adolf_primary.title: Adolf Munkel classic day
d3_adolf_primary.summary: Best meadow + hut + Odle wall day of the trip.
d3_adolf_primary.whenToUse: Use when you want one of the strongest beauty-per-effort meadow hikes.
logistics: No lift. Park at Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss).
Reserve if possible and watch the Ranui signal system.
d3_adolf_primary.mentalMap: Open meadow trail with hut and toothy Odle backdrop.

d3_santa_alt.title: Santa Maddalena alternate day
d3_santa_alt.summary: Lower-effort church/meadow day if you want something softer and more village-oriented.
d3_santa_alt.whenToUse: Best if you feel tired or want lower-commitment scenery.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: Santa Maddalena village / designated parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); visitor-center area backup (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d3_santa_alt.mentalMap: Church, fields, farms, and postcard framing.

d3_val_bad.title: Val di Funes scenic drive
d3_val_bad.summary: Best true poor-weather replacement for Adolf Munkel from the Schgaguler base.
d3_val_bad.whenToUse: Use when summit visibility is poor or rain/storm risk is too high.
logistics: Easy scenic day with photo stops.
Can pair with a very short Santa Maddalena walk.

d4_alpe_primary.title: Santa Maddalena / softer-weather postcard day
d4_alpe_primary.summary: Use Day 4 for the softer church / meadow / village day after your bigger West-side hikes.
d4_alpe_primary.whenToUse: Best on a mixed-weather day or when you want a more relaxed scenic day before moving east.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: Santa Maddalena village / designated parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); visitor-center area backup (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d4_alpe_primary.mentalMap: Church, fields, farms, and postcard framing.

d4_bullaccia_alt.title: Larger Alpe di Siusi alternate day
d4_bullaccia_alt.summary: Use this if Day 1 weather was poor and you still want a stronger plateau day before moving east.
d4_bullaccia_alt.whenToUse: Best if you did not already use one of the higher-payoff Alpe di Siusi hikes on Day 1.
logistics: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).
Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern).
Drive-up fallback: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you are already on the plateau early.
costs: Same lift / parking costs as primary plateau access

d4_sellaronda_bad.title: Sellaronda scenic drive
d4_sellaronda_bad.summary: Best full bad-weather backup for the plateau day.
d4_sellaronda_bad.whenToUse: Use when lift/plateau weather is not worth committing to.
logistics: Pass loop with easy scenic pull-offs.
d4_sellaronda_bad.mentalMap: Road-based pass scenery in place of the plateau.

d5_transfer_cinque.title: Kastelruth → Dobbiaco scenic transfer + Cinque Torri
d5_transfer_cinque.summary: Use the move from Schgaguler to Golden Hill efficiently with scenic pass driving and a medium-effort rocky-rifugio hike.
d5_transfer_cinque.whenToUse: Best as the main hotel-transfer day from Schgaguler to Golden Hill.

accessRoutes.label: Schgaguler → scenic transfer → Bai de Dones → Golden Hill

logistics: Park at Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).
Optional 5 Torri chairlift from Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones) if you want to skip the lower ascent.
d5_transfer_cinque.mentalMap: No-wasted-transfer day through dramatic passes and rifugi.

d5_transfer_drive_only.title: Scenic transfer to Dobbiaco only
d5_transfer_drive_only.summary: Best if weather is not good enough to justify Cinque Torri hiking on the transfer from Schgaguler to Golden Hill.
d5_transfer_drive_only.whenToUse: Use when the drive itself will still be rewarding but the hike is not worth the effort.
logistics: Use this as the default fallback if hiking conditions are poor.
d5_transfer_drive_only.mentalMap: Scenic relocation day through the passes without forcing a hike.

d6_trecime_primary.title: Tre Cime + Cadini hero day
d6_trecime_primary.summary: Biggest icon day of the trip, using one Auronzo booking efficiently.
d6_trecime_primary.whenToUse: Use on the clearest East-side day.
logistics: No lift. Park at Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking).
Auronzo reservation is mandatory; same parking serves Tre Cime and Cadini.
d6_trecime_primary.mentalMap: Hero white-rock day with the two most iconic Auronzo-zone payoffs.

d6_cinque_alt.title: Cinque Torri alternate day
d6_cinque_alt.summary: Use if the Tre Cime day is not getting the sky it deserves.
d6_cinque_alt.whenToUse: Best if East-side high icons are too clouded, but mid-elevation pass scenery still works.
logistics: Park at Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).
Optional 5 Torri chairlift from Bai de Dones (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).

d6_east_drive_bad.title: Passo Giau longer East scenic loop
d6_east_drive_bad.summary: Longer true bad-weather replacement for the Auronzo hero day if you still want a full road-trip day from Golden Hill.
d6_east_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when cloud cover or storm risk makes the Auronzo reservation not worthwhile.
logistics: Good road-based East-side scenery with easy stops.
d6_east_drive_bad.mentalMap: Longer pass-and-lake day when you still want a fuller East scenic drive.

d7_sorapis_primary.title: East-side weather-flex hike day
d7_sorapis_primary.summary: Primary East follow-up if weather is decent after your Tre Cime day.
d7_sorapis_primary.whenToUse: Use when weather is decent and you still want one final substantial East-side hike.
logistics: No lift. Park near Passo Tre Croci (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Passo+Tre+Croci).
Arrive early because parking is limited.
d7_sorapis_primary.mentalMap: Turquoise-lake day with a more adventurous feel than the meadow hikes.

d7_trecime_swap_alt.title: Tre Cime + Cadini swap day
d7_trecime_swap_alt.summary: Use this if Day 6 weather was poor and you saved the Auronzo reservation for today.
d7_trecime_swap_alt.whenToUse: Best if yesterday was clouded out but today is clear.
logistics: No lift. Park at Rifugio Auronzo parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking).
Auronzo reservation is mandatory if you swap Tre Cime into Day 7.
d7_trecime_swap_alt.mentalMap: Weather-flex swap version of the hero day.

d7_east_drive_bad.title: Passo Giau longer East scenic loop
d7_east_drive_bad.summary: Longer East-side scenic fallback on the final Dolomites day if you want a fuller drive than the Misurina corridor.
d7_east_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when a full Sorapis hike is not worth it.
logistics: Flexible final-day road loop.
d7_east_drive_bad.mentalMap: Longer East scenic day with passes, villages, and Misurina.

d8_venice_transfer.title: Golden Hill → Venice transfer
d8_venice_transfer.summary: Simple exit day from Golden Hill with optional Misurina stop if weather is beautiful.
logistics: Optional short lake stop if skies are beautiful.
d8_venice_transfer.mentalMap: Clean exit with optional final scenic pause.

d1_alpe_primary.title: Arrival-day Alpe di Siusi ROI hike
d1_alpe_primary.summary: Best use of your short Lake Garda transfer day: check in at Schgaguler, use lift access, and spend the afternoon on the pretty plateau.
d1_alpe_primary.whenToUse: Use on arrival day when weather up high is decent and you want the strongest beauty-per-hour start.
logistics: Lift recommended: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola).
Best parking: Garage Mont Sëuc (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) right at the lift station.
Use lift access to skip the less interesting approach and keep time for Ortisei town later.
costs: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip
bookings: Day-of usually fine; earlier is better if you want more buffer.
d1_alpe_primary.mentalMap: Fast transfer, pretty high meadow hike, then town time.

d1_tschotsch_alt.title: Shorter arrival-day Alpe di Siusi option
d1_tschotsch_alt.summary: Shorter scenic plateau outing if you want to keep Day 1 especially easy.
d1_tschotsch_alt.whenToUse: Best if you arrive a little later or want a lighter first day.

accessRoutes.label: Hotel → Seis-Seiser Alm cableway valley station

logistics: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).
Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern).
Drive-up fallback: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you are already on the plateau early.
d1_tschotsch_alt.mentalMap: Short, scenic plateau sampler with time left for town.

d6_misurina_drive_bad.title: Tre Cime / Misurina mini-drive
d6_misurina_drive_bad.summary: Closest low-commitment scenic replacement from Golden Hill if the Auronzo reservation or upper-hike weather is not worth forcing.
d6_misurina_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when visibility is mixed or unstable and you want a nearby half-day fallback rather than a long road loop.
logistics: Easy East-side lake-and-corridor fallback from Golden Hill.
Can stay short or stretch with photo stops.
d6_misurina_drive_bad.mentalMap: Nearby lake-and-approach scenery instead of forcing the hero day.

d7_misurina_drive_alt.title: Tre Cime / Misurina mini-drive
d7_misurina_drive_alt.summary: Closest half-day scenic fallback from Golden Hill if you do not want to commit to Sorapis on the final full day.
d7_misurina_drive_alt.whenToUse: Use when weather is mixed or energy is lower and you want a shorter drive than Passo Giau.
logistics: Easy to pair with a relaxed Dobbiaco afternoon.

d1_family_alt.title: Easy arrival-day Alpe di Siusi family-style option
d1_family_alt.summary: Easy scenic plateau option if you want broad meadows and classic Dolomite backdrop without pushing the first day too much.
d1_family_alt.whenToUse: Best if you arrive on time but want a softer, more relaxed first hike than Monte Piz.

accessRoutes.label: Hotel → Seis-Seiser Alm cableway valley station

logistics: Lift recommended: Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).
Best parking: free open parking at the valley station or Car park Silbernagl (P1) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern).
Drive-up fallback: P2 Compatsch (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) if you are already on the plateau early.
costs: Seis cable car fare or plateau parking fees apply.
d1_family_alt.mentalMap: Easy upper-plateau meadows and views with less commitment.

d4_urtijei_alt.title: Longer Alpe di Siusi alternate day
d4_urtijei_alt.summary: Use this if Day 1 weather was poor and you want a fuller Mont Sëuc / Alpe di Siusi day before moving east.
d4_urtijei_alt.whenToUse: Best if you want more plateau time and are happy to trade a bit more effort for scenery.
logistics: Lift recommended: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola).
Best parking: Garage Mont Sëuc (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) at the lift station.
costs: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; parking extra.
d4_urtijei_alt.mentalMap: Longer open-plateau loop with Mont Sëuc access.

d3_zans_glatsch_alt.title: Lighter Zans / Glatsch Alm alternate day
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.summary: Lighter Val di Funes / Zans backup if you want an easier hut-and-meadow day than the full Adolf Munkel classic.
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.whenToUse: Best when weather is decent but you want a lower-effort valley day.
logistics: No lift. Park at Zans Parking (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss).
Reserve/check access if possible and watch the Ranui signal system.
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.mentalMap: Shorter Zans hut loop with Odle backdrop.
